sections.title: Income tax: first EC$30,000 free, 15% on the next EC$20,000, 25% on the next EC$30,000, 35% above
sections.basis: chargeable income of resident individuals, unincorporated bodies and trustees; the 0% band is the EC$30,000 resident allowance

rows.label: Resident allowance
rows.note: every resident individual (the 0% band of the scale).

rows.label: Mortgage interest allowance: limit
rows.note: mortgage interest of owners who live in their residential property.

source.title: Personal income tax: returns, allowances and deductions

rows.label: Student loan relief: limit per student
rows.note: each student's loan with a financial institution in Dominica.

source.title: Personal income tax: returns, allowances and deductions

rows.label: Donations to approved institutions
rows.value: Contributions of EC$1,000 to EC$20,000 to the special fund of the Carnival Organizing Committee, and donations to institutions approved by Cabinet (Education Trust Fund, Princess Margaret Hospital Trust Fund and others), are deductible.

source.title: Personal income tax: returns, allowances and deductions

rows.label: PAYE: monthly bands
rows.value: Employers deduct PAYE monthly: the resident allowance is EC$2,500 a month, the next EC$1,666.67 is taxed at 15%, the next EC$2,500 at 25% and monthly chargeable income above EC$6,666.67 at 35%; remitted within 15 days after the month.

sections.title: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents

rows.label: Withholding tax on payments to non-residents
rows.note: dividends, interest, rents, royalties, management charges, commissions, fees, annuities and other income payments to non-residents.

rows.label: Corporate income tax
rows.note: net profit of companies.

rows.label: Corporate income tax: instalments
rows.value: Companies pay three quarterly instalments a year (25%, 35% and 40%) and file within 3 months after the end of the financial year.

rows.label: VAT standard rate
rows.note: every taxable supply in Dominica and taxable imports.

rows.label: VAT on accommodation and diving
rows.note: accommodation and diving activities.

rows.label: Excise tax: beer, stout and wine (per litre)
rows.note: stout, beer and wine imported or manufactured. Under review: the IRD's excise page cites the Excise Tax Act 2005 and orders up to 2008; later changes to the specific rates were not checked on an official page. Unit: per litre.

rows.label: Excise tax: rum, liquor and cordial (per litre)
rows.note: rum (also liquor and cordial). Under review: the IRD's excise page cites the Excise Tax Act 2005 and orders up to 2008; later changes to the specific rates were not checked on an official page. Unit: per litre.

rows.label: Excise tax: whiskey (per litre)
rows.note: whiskey (brandy, gin and vodka: EC$8.50 per litre). Under review: the IRD's excise page cites the Excise Tax Act 2005 and orders up to 2008; later changes to the specific rates were not checked on an official page. Unit: per litre.

rows.label: Excise tax: cigarettes (per kg)
rows.note: cigarettes. Under review: the IRD's excise page cites the Excise Tax Act 2005 and orders up to 2008; later changes to the specific rates were not checked on an official page. Unit: per kg.

rows.label: Excise tax: gasoline (per gallon)
rows.note: gasoline. Under review: the IRD's excise page cites the Excise Tax Act 2005 and orders up to 2008; later changes to the specific rates were not checked on an official page. Unit: per gallon.

rows.label: Excise tax: diesel (per gallon)
rows.note: diesel. Under review: the IRD's excise page cites the Excise Tax Act 2005 and orders up to 2008; later changes to the specific rates were not checked on an official page. Unit: per gallon.

rows.label: Registration of a motor vehicle or trailer
rows.note: registration of a motor vehicle or trailer (motor cycle: EC$60).

rows.label: Motor vehicle licence: commercial vehicle up to 2,240 lbs
rows.note: commercial vehicle not exceeding 2,240 lbs (EC$275 for a half year).

rows.label: Highway maintenance levy: private vehicles
rows.note: private vehicles, paid with the annual licence (commercial vehicles, trucks and dumpers EC$150; motor cycles EC$50). Under review: the IRD page presents these as 'the proposed rates'; whether they were enacted as published was not confirmed.

rows.label: Travel tax on tickets
rows.note: every travel ticket purchased or issued in Dominica, or anywhere for a journey commencing in Dominica. In force under the Travel Tax (Amendment) Act No. 13 of 2003; 1 January 2003 is used as the start of that year (the exact commencement date is not on the page).
